exposure: Resistance index (RI) of blood flow in the anterior wall of the lower uterine segment
outcome: Efficacy of surgical treatment for CSP
cohort: The study included 75 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy requesting termination of pregnancy and 75 normal pregnant women, all with a history of cesarean section.
finding: Combined transvaginal color Doppler ultrasound parameters (CSM, minimum sagittal muscle thickness, and RI) demonstrate high diagnostic value for CSP and its sub-types, with gestational sac size and CSM being independent factors affecting CSP treatment efficacy.
mod_finding: The study focuses on Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP), a complication arising specifically from a previous cesarean section, thus intrinsically linking its findings to this mode of birth.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of suspected or diagnosed Cesarean Scar Pregnancy.
